### Artaban · AURA — Historian & analytics
`ROS 2 / Vulcanexus` → `Orion-LD (NGSI-LD, DDS bridge)` → `TROE · TimescaleDB` → `Mintaka` → **Grafana**  ·  Powered by FIWARE · ARISE all-in-one middleware  ·  [Open AURA dashboard (WireCloud) ↗](http://localhost:8000/admin/aura)

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (entityid, id) entityid, split_part(id, '/', -1) AS attr, number, text, boolean,
         coalesce(observedat, ts) AS t
  FROM attributes
  WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:MissionReport:%'
  ORDER BY entityid, id, ts DESC
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Missions", avg(sr) AS "Avg success", avg(fa) AS "Avg false activation",
  avg(lat) AS "Avg latency", avg(loops) AS "Loops / 10 cmds", sum(alerts) AS "Alerts"
FROM (SELECT entityid, max(t) AS t,
  max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'commandSuccessRate') AS "sr", max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'falseActivationRate') AS "fa",
  max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'meanLatency') AS "lat", max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'confirmationLoopRate') AS "loops", max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'alertsCount') AS "alerts"
  FROM r GROUP BY entityid) m
WHERE $__timeFilter(t)

panels.title: Command success rate per mission
panels.description: Trend across sprints is the evidence package required by ARISE (PoC → TRL 6–7)

WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (entityid, id) entityid, split_part(id, '/', -1) AS attr, number, text, boolean,
         coalesce(observedat, ts) AS t
  FROM attributes
  WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:MissionReport:%'
  ORDER BY entityid, id, ts DESC
)
SELECT split_part(entityid, ':', 4) AS "Mission",
  max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'commandSuccessRate') AS "Success %", max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'rejectionRate') AS "Rejection %",
  max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'falseActivationRate') AS "False activation %", max(number) FILTER (WHERE attr = 'confirmationLoopRate') AS "Loops / 10",

panels.title: Performance by acoustic condition
panels.description: Noise + mask triggers fallback to gesture + thermal cues; watch the confirmation-loop rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT compound->>'acoustic_condition' AS "Condition", count(*) AS "Commands",
  100 * avg(CASE WHEN compound->>'outcome' IN ('correct','recovered') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Success",
  avg((compound->>'confidence')::float) AS "Mean confidence",
  10 * avg(CASE WHEN (compound->>'decision')::int = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Loops / 10",
  avg((compound->>'latency_ms')::float) AS "Mean latency"
FROM (WITH raw AS (
  SELECT entityid, id, ts, observedat, valuetype, compound::jsonb AS compound,
         compound->>'mission_id' AS mission_id, compound->>'event_id' AS event_id,
         nullif(coalesce((compound#>>'{header,stamp,sec}')::numeric, 0)
                + coalesce((compound#>>'{header,stamp,nanosec}')::numeric, 0) / 1e9, 0) AS stamp
  FROM attributes
  WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:intent' AND id LIKE '%/intentEvent' AND valuetype = 'Compound'
), orig AS (  -- the first sample of each decision
  SELECT a.* FROM raw a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw b WHERE b.ts < a.ts
    AND b.event_id = a.event_id AND b.mission_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.mission_id AND CASE WHEN a.stamp IS NOT NULL AND b.stamp IS NOT NULL THEN abs(a.stamp - b.stamp) <= 0.001 ELSE b.ts >= a.ts - interval '10 minutes' END)
), member AS (  -- every sample, with the decision it belongs to (the latest matching first sample)
  SELECT a.ts AS orig_ts, a.event_id, a.mission_id, b.ts, b.compound FROM orig a
  JOIN raw b ON b.ts >= a.ts AND b.event_id = a.event_id AND b.mission_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.mission_id AND CASE WHEN a.stamp IS NOT NULL AND b.stamp IS NOT NULL THEN abs(a.stamp - b.stamp) <= 0.001 ELSE TRUE END
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orig c WHERE c.ts > a.ts AND c.ts <= b.ts AND c.event_id = b.event_id AND c.mission_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.mission_id AND CASE WHEN b.stamp IS NOT NULL AND c.stamp IS NOT NULL THEN abs(b.stamp - c.stamp) <= 0.001 ELSE TRUE END)
), feedback AS (  -- latest non-empty value of each feedback field
  SELECT orig_ts, event_id, mission_id,
    (array_agg(compound->>'outcome' ORDER BY ts DESC)
       FILTER (WHERE coalesce(compound->>'outcome', '') <> ''))[1] AS outcome,
    (array_agg((compound->>'correct')::boolean ORDER BY ts DESC)
       FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'correct')::boolean OR coalesce(compound->>'outcome', '') <> ''))[1] AS correct,
    (array_agg((compound->>'time_to_safe_stop_ms')::float ORDER BY ts DESC)
       FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'time_to_safe_stop_ms')::float > 0))[1] AS time_to_safe_stop_ms,
    (array_agg((compound->>'recovery_time_s')::float ORDER BY ts DESC)
       FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'recovery_time_s')::float > 0))[1] AS recovery_time_s
  FROM member GROUP BY orig_ts, event_id, mission_id
)
SELECT o.entityid, o.id, o.ts, o.observedat, o.valuetype,
       o.compound || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
         'outcome', f.outcome, 'correct', f.correct,
         'time_to_safe_stop_ms', f.time_to_safe_stop_ms, 'recovery_time_s', f.recovery_time_s)) AS compound
FROM orig o LEFT JOIN feedback f
  ON f.orig_ts = o.ts AND f.event_id = o.event_id AND f.mission_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.mission_id) AS intent_events
WHERE coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND (compound->>'decision')::int <> 3
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Calibration · reliability diagram
panels.description: Confidence calibration quality: bars match when confidence predicts errors well (gap = ECE contribution).

  avg(CASE WHEN compound->>'outcome' = 'correct' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Observed accuracy"

panels.title: Per-operator profile (inclusiveness: who struggles with what)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT compound->>'operator_id' AS "Operator", count(*) AS "Commands",
  100 * avg(CASE WHEN compound->>'outcome' IN ('correct','recovered') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Success",
  100 * avg(CASE WHEN compound->>'outcome' = 'false_activation' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "False act.",

         'time_to_safe_stop_ms', f.time_to_safe_stop_ms, 'recovery_time_s', f.recovery_time_s)) AS compound
FROM orig o LEFT JOIN feedback f
  ON f.orig_ts = o.ts AND f.event_id = o.event_id AND f.mission_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.mission_id) AS intent_events
WHERE coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND (compound->>'decision')::int <> 3
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Command success via Mintaka temporal API
panels.description: HRISessionKPI.commandSuccessRate (rolling 15 min) fetched through the standard NGSI-LD temporal API (GET /temporal/entities/{id}) served by FIWARE Mintaka — the interoperable path for external IT/OT systems. Entities created by Orion-LD 1.10's DDS bridge have no TROE entity record, so Mintaka cannot serve them yet; the SQL panels read their history directly.
